items.html: And if you say: Are not these two coronets the two lower segments of Arich Anpin themselves, which descended within the Daat of ZA; while the Hochma and Bina are drawn from the drop drawn from the inheritance of Aba and Ima, and are not those very segments, but only a drop drawn from them — then the power of Daat is greater than the power of Hochma and Bina.
